_nota: Anuncio pagado para papás (Meta/TikTok) que lleva al reto diario en pasas.mx/arcade. Fondos con OpenAI: workflow 'Fondos de anuncios' → video/arte/<slug>/reel-NN.jpg. Render: node src/anuncio.mjs --data data/anuncios/2026-10-reto-historia-papas.json

arte.universo: Ancient Tenochtitlan at golden hour, original and respectful, like a museum diorama come to life: the great twin-temple pyramid of the Templo Mayor with its stairs, white plastered buildings, canals with small wooden canoes, floating chinampa gardens full of flowers and corn, the two snowy volcanoes on the horizon, warm sunset sky turning purple, glowing lanterns, flower petals and golden particles in the air. Stone tablets, codex-like painted panels and feathers appear as props, but every symbol on them is an abstract geometric shape (no letters, no glyphs that read as text). No warriors, no weapons, no battles, no real historical people: the only character is the Pasita, a curious explorer with a small backpack.
